snippet.title: Guitar Hero World Tour: Definitive Edition - 2nd Year Anniversary Trailer
snippet.description:
https://ghwt.de/
(Alternate link: https://ghwtde.gitlab.io/)

It's been another whole year with GHWT:DE, so here's a small trailer showcasing what's been done to the mod throughout 2023. 

For those that don't know, Guitar Hero World Tour: Definitive Edition is a fan-made nonprofit mod to the PC port of GHWT which adds loads of content from other GH and Neversoft-developed titles.
